{{Navbar-Global_Coal_Plant_Tracker}}
'''Shanxi Ruiguang power station''' (山西国际能源瑞光热电公司热电联产) is an operating power station of at least 660-megawatts (MW) in Wujinshan, Yuci, Jinzhong, Shanxi, China with multiple units, some of which are not currently operating.

==Ownership Tree==

This ownership tree is part of the [https://globalenergymonitor.org/projects/global-energy-ownership-tracker/ Global Energy Ownership Tracker], a project of Global Energy Monitor.

{{#widget:ObservableOwnershipTree|}}

==Background==

The two existing coal-fired units of Shanxi Ruiguang power station, totaling 660 MW, were brought online between 2011 and 2012. The plant is owned by [[Shanxi International Electricity Group]].<ref>[http://bit.ly/1sdFQ4i "关于山西瑞光热电有限责任公司一期(2×300MW)供热机组进入商业运营的批复"], 山西省人民政府, 2012-07-23</ref><ref>[http://bit.ly/Zg59rK "省经信委胡玉亭主任一行到山西国际能源(格盟国际)瑞光热电公司调研"], 国际能源网, 2013-07-11</ref>

==Description of Expansion==

Shanxi International Energy Group is currently planning to build two additional coal-fired units at this plant, with a total planned capacity of 1,200 MW.<ref>[http://bit.ly/1tt2Ji9 "瑞光热电1号机组圆满通过168小时试运行"], 国际能源网, 2011-12-23</ref>

However, with no developments since 2011, the expansion appears to be cancelled.
